silencer.description: [MAFIA] Silent mafia member who can silence players during the day.
silencer.player: At night, tell who to silence
silencer.narrator: During night, ask who to silence and note down. During the day, announce who is silenced.

mafia.description: [MAFIA] Standard mafia member who eliminates villagers at night.
mafia.player: Work with other mafia members to eliminate villagers
mafia.narrator: Mafia members work together to choose who to eliminate each night

villager.description: [VILLAGE] Standard villager trying to identify and eliminate all mafia members.
villager.player: During the day, vote to eliminate suspected mafia members
villager.narrator: Villagers win when all mafia are eliminated

police.description: [VILLAGE] Investigator who can check if a player is mafia or not each night.
police.player: At night, choose one player to investigate. You'll learn if they are mafia or not.
police.narrator: During night, ask who to investigate and privately tell the police if the target is mafia or not

doctor.description: [VILLAGE] Healer who can protect one player from elimination each night.
doctor.player: At night, choose one player to protect (including yourself). They cannot be eliminated that night.
doctor.narrator: During night, ask who to protect. If mafia targets the protected player, the elimination fails
